page.title: Receipt
page.purpose: Show live document processing receipts with an explicit local residency summary, privacy class, MIME, and parse tier.

priorities.statement: Locality is stated in the summary and on every visible processing step.
Privacy class and processing tier remain readable beside the document identity.
An empty receipt is distinct from a loaded receipt list.

states.description: Receipt documents are loaded with local processing and tier details.
The receipt API is reachable but no documents have processing receipts.
The receipt API failed and the surface remains usable with an empty state.

claims.statement: The receipt exposes a named processing timeline region.
The loaded receipt states Local in a dedicated residency summary.
The processing timeline is exposed in normal document order to assistive technology.
Populated, empty, and error states are distinct.
